title: Rokumon Sort
name: Rokumon Sort
description: Pour forge pigments into crystal vials until every tube is a single sealed colour.

scoring.campaign: Sum of best level scores. Each clear is stars × 500 plus a par bonus.
scoring.endless: Cumulative Night Pour run score. Higher is better.

bridge.transport: window.Hub when present, otherwise postMessage to the parent frame with targetOrigin set to the game's own origin. Nothing is sent when the game is not framed.
bridge.score: Hub.score(number) after every clear: the campaign total or the current Night Pour run score.
bridge.gameOver: Hub.gameOver(number, durationMs?) when gate 20 is cleared and when a Night Pour run ends.
